cat > /tmp/check_closes.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

echo "=== Distinct Close Method Declarations (non-test backend) ==="
echo

declare -A declarations

# Find all Close method declarations
while IFS= read -r line; do
    file=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f1)
    lineno=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f2)
    
    # Extract the type name
    type=$(grep "^func (.*) Close()" "$file" | sed -n "$((lineno - lineno + 1))p" | sed 's/.*(\([^[:space:]]*\)[[:space:]]*\*\?\([^)]*\)).*/\2/')
    
    if [ -z "${declarations[$type]}" ]; then
        declarations[$type]="$file:$lineno"
    fi
done < <(find /bench/repo -name "*.go" ! -path "*/proto/gen/*" ! -path "*/.git/*" ! -path "*/web/*" ! -path "*/docs/*" ! -name "*_test.go" -exec grep -n "func (.*) Close()" {} +)

count=0
for type in "${!declarations[@]}"; do
    ((count++))
    echo "$count. Type: $type at ${declarations[$type]}"
done

echo
echo "=== Close Methods Actually Called by Non-Test Server Code ==="
echo

# From our earlier search, the calls to custom types' Close() are:
